title: Inflammation-activated neuronal and astrocytic populations in the dorsal bed nucleus of the stria terminalis modulate peripheral immune response via the brain-spleen axis
title_zh: 炎症激活的背侧床核与星形胶质细胞群体通过脑-脾轴调节外周免疫反应
abstract: Abstract The brain detects peripheral inflammatory signals and modulates immune responses, yet the forebrain mechanisms that participate in this process remain incompletely understood. Here, we find that the projection from the dorsal bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (dBNST) to the dorsal vagal complex (DVC) can regulate LPS-induced splenic immune responses. Using chemogenetic and optogenetic approaches, we show that lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-activated Fos + neuronal populations in the dBNST participate in the regulation of splenic immune cells. Inhibition of these neurons attenuates LPS-induced pro-inflammatory cytokine production and splenic nerve activation, and alters the number of splenic immune cells. Neural tracing combined with optogenetic functional validation provides evidence for a polysynaptic dBNST-DVC-spleen pathway through which Fos dBNST neurons can influence splenic nerve activity and the number of splenic immune cells. We further show that LPS recruits a subpopulation of dBNST astrocytes, and selective activation of these astrocytes is sufficient to enhance dBNST neuronal excitability and alter the number of splenic immune cells. Notably, the injection of LPS elevates adenosine triphosphate (ATP) levels around dBNST astrocytes, which activates P2Y 1 receptors and promotes glutamate release, thereby increasing local neuronal excitability. Together, our findings reveal a coordinated neuron-astrocyte mechanism in the dBNST that processes immune signals during acute LPS-induced inflammatory responses, implicate astrocytes as important modulators in forebrain regulation of peripheral immunity, and provide a new framework for understanding forebrain regulation of splenic immune responses under acute inflammatory conditions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 大脑检测外周炎症信号并调节免疫反应，但参与此过程的前脑机制尚未完全阐明。我们发现背侧床核（dBNST）向背侧迷走神经复合体（DVC）的投射可调节脂多糖（LPS）诱导的脾脏免疫反应。通过化学遗传学和光遗传学方法，我们显示LPS激活的dBNST Fos+神经元群体参与调节脾脏免疫细胞。抑制这些神经元可减弱LPS诱导的促炎细胞因子产生和脾神经激活，并改变脾脏免疫细胞数量。神经追踪结合光遗传功能验证提供了多突触dBNST-DVC-脾脏通路的证据，Fos+ dBNST 神经元可影响脾神经活动和脾脏免疫细胞数量。我们进一步发现LPS招募了一部分dBNST星形胶质细胞，选择性激活这些星形胶质细胞足以增强dBNST神经元兴奋性并改变脾脏免疫细胞数量。值得注意的是，LPS注射可升高dBNST星形胶质细胞周围的三磷酸腺苷（ATP）水平，激活P2Y1受体并促进谷氨酸释放，从而增加局部神经元兴奋性。综上所述，我们的研究揭示了dBNST中神经元-星形胶质细胞协同机制，在急性LPS诱导的炎症反应中处理免疫信号，提示星形胶质细胞是前脑调节外周免疫的重要调节者，并为理解急性炎症条件下前脑调节脾脏免疫反应提供了新框架。
